modifiers.note: Barracks, Siege Works and Migdol Strongholds cost -25% Gold.
Units trained in a Barracks/Migdol Stronghold within 20 of a Monument cost -10% (Devotees aura).

meta.note: Other bonuses: Pharaoh summons Animals of Set (Favor); Priests convert wild animals (-25% Food); +5% speed for Spearmen, Axemen, Slingers. Free animals on age-up (not expressible): Classical 1 Hyena + 2 Gazelles of Set, Heroic 1 Crocodile + 2 Giraffes of Set, Mythic 1 Rhinoceros + 2 Hippopotamuses of Set (spawn at a Temple). Vision recharge 240 s.
